title: About Plan Well
subtitle: Plan Well helps users create personalized 7-day Indian meal plans to support healthy eating and weight-loss goals based on their preferences and lifestyle.

sections.title: About Plan Well
content: Plan Well is a nutrition planning website designed to simplify weekly meal planning for people following an Indian diet.
The website generates personalized 7-day meal plans based on your weight, state, dietary preference, and preferred number of meals per day.
Its primary focus is to help users build healthier eating habits and support their weight-loss journey through structured meal planning.

sections.title: Who Can Use Plan Well?
content: Plan Well is suitable for anyone looking for a simple and organized way to plan healthy meals throughout the week.
Whether you are beginning your weight-loss journey, trying to improve your eating habits, or simply want a structured weekly meal plan, Plan Well provides an easy starting point.

sections.title: Key Features
content: Plan Well makes meal planning simple while giving users enough flexibility to create a plan that matches their preferences.
bullets: Adjustable number of meals per day
Delete saved meal plans at any time

sections.title: How to Use
content: You can generate a meal plan without signing in. If you sign in with Google, your meal plans will be saved automatically.
Enter your weight, choose your state, select your dietary preference, and choose how many meals you want each day. Plan Well will generate a personalized 7-day meal plan for you.
Review the daily meals and weekly summary. If you are signed in, you can return to My Meal Plans at any time to view or delete your saved plans.
bullets: Delete saved meal plans whenever you want

sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions
bullets: Do I need to sign in? No. You can generate meal plans without signing in. Signing in simply allows your meal plans to be saved.
Can I create multiple meal plans? Yes. You can generate as many meal plans as you like.
Are my saved meal plans private? Yes. Your saved meal plans are linked only to your Google account.
Can I delete my saved meal plans? Yes. You can delete them at any time from My Meal Plans.
Can I generate meal plans for different states? Yes. You can choose a different state whenever you generate a new meal plan.

sections.title: About the Developer
content: Plan Well was developed as a portfolio project to demonstrate the design and development of a complete web application focused on personalized nutrition planning.
The project emphasizes a clean user experience, practical meal planning, secure user accounts, and cloud-based storage for saved meal plans.
The website will continue to improve as new features and enhancements are added over time.

sections.title: Disclaimer
content: Plan Well is designed to help users create structured meal plans and support healthier eating habits.
The meal plans generated by the website are intended for educational and planning purposes only and should not be considered medical, nutritional, or professional healthcare advice.

If you have any medical conditions, dietary restrictions, or specific health concerns, please consult a qualified healthcare professional or registered dietitian before making significant changes to your diet.
